quality_mask: Applied before downsampling; mask values 1..254 valid, 0 and 255 excluded
confidence: exploratory; threshold and temporal-difference filters applied
evidence: Mosaic assembled from matching repeat NISAR track/direction/frame pairs. Overlapping scenes are median-offset aligned and edge-feather blended to reduce tile seams.
The change layer is masked to the Natural Earth Caspian-water polygon; land pixels are transparent.
Shoreline-change candidates are restricted to a 15-pixel band around the Natural Earth reference shoreline.
Candidate pixels require a 2 dB margin from both date-specific thresholds and at least 3 dB temporal backscatter difference.
All contributing scenes use one consistent polarization (HHHH preferred, otherwise HVHV) and require the GCOV mask; mask values 0 and 255 are excluded before downsampling.
Water classification is exploratory; wind, waves, vegetation, soil moisture and radar geometry can mimic shoreline change.
coverage.png shows valid NISAR observation availability, not the shoreline. reference.png is Natural Earth reference geography, not an observation.
Processed 1 frame pairs; tile dates range from 2026-11-06 to 2026-11-18.
